approach: Static recompilation with N64ModernRuntime and RT64; ClayFighter 63⅓ gameplay foundation with the four additional Sculptor's Cut characters.
notes: Community fusion of ClayFighter 63⅓ and ClayFighter: Sculptor's Cut, retaining the 63⅓ gameplay foundation and expanding the roster to sixteen characters. Includes Training Mode, portable settings, per-action combat remapping and controller-aware prompts. Created with AI assistance.
